summary: YPF S.A. disclosed via Form 6-K (Argentine material event notice to the CNV, dated September 14, 2026) that its wholly controlled unit Vaca Muerta Inversiones S.A. closed the assignment to Pluspetrol S.A. of a 20% interest in the Temporary Joint Venture contracts covering the La Escalonada and Rincón La Ceniza Areas in Neuquén, plus related joint operating agreements. Conditions precedent were satisfied; VMI retains 25%. No price, premium, advisor or board recommendation was stated. The disclosure follows prior notices of January 22 and April 30, 2026. Watch for purchase-price terms, regulatory filings and Vaca Muerta partnership economics.
